title: Creativanta Video Engine Composition Specification 1.0
description: Canonical composition specification for deterministic code-driven video rendering (docs/SCENE-SPEC.md).

schema_version.description: Canonical schema version, strictly 1.0 for v1

width.description: Width in pixels (positive even integer, max 3840)

height.description: Height in pixels (positive even integer, max 3840)

background.description: Background color in #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA hex format

num.description: Numerator of the rational frame rate (positive integer)

den.description: Denominator of the rational frame rate (positive integer)

duration_frames.description: Total duration in frames (1 to 10800 frames, e.g. up to 360s at 30fps)

id.description: Local identifier of font inside composition

asset_id.description: Server-issued asset ID for font file

sha256.description: Lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 digest of font file

scenes.description: Ordered contiguous timeline scenes (1 to 50 scenes)

audio_tracks.description: Explicit audio track placements (up to 16 tracks)
